title: devx SDK todo - quick fixes and sample apps
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs/devx (quick list, rough notes)

Date: 2026-03-09
Owner: Samantha Lee
Context: follow-ups after pairing w/ Alex on quickstart flow + review from QE. Mostly TODOs and tiny fixes to unblock sample-apps and tutorials.

Top priorities (shippable quick wins)
- Fix Python quickstart snippet (README) — auth header vs client-init confusion. Currently examples show both patterns (token env vs client(api_key=...)) -> standardize to env var REDWOOD_API_KEY + example for ServiceAccounts. Add explicit retry/backoff example for streaming socket.
  - TODO: update readme code block, run linter for code fences. (alex assigned)
- Streaming example in JS docs fails for long responses (missing await on iterator). Add small e2e test and CI job to run sample-app after small runtime change.
  - TODO: write test in tests/integration/quickstart_stream.test.ts (devon)
- Embeddings sample-app: include batching recommendation (batch size 64 default) + show cost calc. Add a small script that reads csv and batches for parallel embedding calls.
  - TODO: add sample-app in samples/embeddings/batch_uploader (mikaela)
- Function-calling tutorial: missing example of structured schema in SDK v0.9 (people hit schema validation errors). Document compatibility matrix for SDK versions and server model variants.
  - TODO: add subsection "Function schema examples" and link to models compatibility table.

Smaller fixes / UX notes (can be followups)
- CLI docs: `rwctl` vs `redwood` naming inconsistent across pages — pick one and run global replace.
- Add note for Private deployments: environment var for KMS integration is REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID (was missing).
- Add troubleshooting note for common 401 patterns (clock skew, token format). Short checklist for support.
- Update screenshot in Console quickstart where "Create API key" button moved in UI. Replace with new screenshot + ALT text.

Open questions / blockers
- Do we want to ship a minimal full-stack sample-app that combines embeddings + reranking + streaming chat? Pros: better show end-to-end cost and routing. Cons: maintenance. Suggest: make it a simple Next.js template with env toggles. (discuss with Product)
- For Dedicated customers, do we need separate SDK examples for dedicated endpoint URLs? Currently docs show hosted api.example.redwood but not dedicated. Add snippet for connecting to custom endpoint + TLS notes.

PRs/Issues to track
- GH PR 412: fix python quickstart (in review)
- GH Issue 254: function-calling schema mismatch (needs longer investigation)

Next actions (today)
- Patch README python snippet + push PR -> assign Alex (target: today EOD)
- Draft embeddings batch uploader skeleton -> assign Mikaela (target: tomorrow)
- Write quick streaming test -> assign Devon (target: 2026-03-11)
- Sync w/ product on sample-app decision (sprint planning Wed)

Notes to self
- Keep notes short in doc; move finalized guides to /shared_drives/product/hosted-api/docs when ready.
- Remember to add `tags: quickstart, example` in front-matter for docs site so they appear in search.

Rough copy snippets to drop in PRs
- Python quickstart (small):
  ```python
  import os
  from redwood import RedwoodClient

  # use env var REDWOOD_API_KEY set in your shell or CI
  client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  resp = client.chat.create(model="redwood-1", input="Hello world")
  print(resp.output_text)
  ```

- JS streaming iterator note:
  ```js
  for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'long prompt' })) {
    process.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
  }
  ```

Quick log
- 09:20 pairing w/ Alex - confirmed python example bug
- 10:15 triage w/ QE - streaming flaky on long outputs
- 11:00 quick sync w/ Mikaela re embeddings exports

End of scratchpad
